skills.name: xlsx-hidden-risk-scan

skills.name: xlsx-to-csv-export
skills.one_line: Exports each worksheet of an .xlsx workbook to its own CSV file with the Python standard library only, copying stored numbers digit for digit and listing formula and error cells.

skills.name: xml-json-converter
skills.one_line: Converts XML to JSON and JSON back to XML under one stated mapping, with attributes as @keys, mixed text as #text, and repeated siblings as arrays.

skills.name: youtube-content-kit
skills.one_line: Turns a video idea into a script outline with a 15-second hook, a chapter list, title, description, tags, a thumbnail brief and a publishing checklist, then validates the package with a script (hook word count, 3+ chapters with increasing timestamps, title and description limits, tag count, sponsorship disclosure).
